name: idle-float-loop
title: Idle Float Loop
description: Multi-element idle float where each child bobs on its own sine wave with independent amplitude, period and phase — a still-life that breathes, with the entire system pausing via one reduced-motion check.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Scatter
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
